tests.intent: Verify that find_zero_byte returns n when no zero byte is present in the contiguous buffer, reaching the return n fallback line.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Verify that non-contiguous stream input parsing with error_handler_t::strict validates string keys via get_bson_cstr and reaches check_string_utf8 through the byte-by-byte path.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Verify find_zero_byte correctly scans strings with length not a multiple of 8, returning the exact index where the zero byte is located within the last partial block.
